title: Harness pace-guard: budget-exceeded edit block
desc: The pace-guard blocks Edit/Write/Update when the active model budget (weekly/monthly/sonnet/gemini) exceeds its target. Escape: delegate to a pace-exempt subagent via Agent.cmd, or do knowledge-ops which are always free. ROOT edits to .md, harness, and doctor code are TIER1-exempt.
steps: TRIGGER: fires on Edit/Write/Update when Get-ClaudePaceInfo shows sonnetHogging or totalExceeded or sonnetExceeded or monthlyExceeded, or Gemini weekly percent over elapsed percent. Read-only tools and skill/.md ops are exempt.

ESCAPE: delegate the edit to a pace-exempt subagent -- Agent.cmd --model haiku. Subagents bypass the pace ceiling. KNOWLEDGE-OPS stay free: wkappbot skill read/edit and any .md edit never pace-block (jisikhwa is always free).

ROOT EXEMPTION: a ROOT (non-agent-child) session edits any .md, the harness scripts (wkharness*.ps1), and wkdoctor modules (bin/wkappbot.hq/doctor/*.ps1) pace-free via Test-WkIsHarnessSourceEdit (TIER1). Arbitrary source stays limited. See: pace-deadlock-escapes-harness-editable-and-jisikhwa-free.
author: claude
